dex.text: A mossy acorn with a face, found among the boulders where the oaks grow crooked. It hums when the fog comes down and goes quiet when anyone listens.
dex.fact: 'Wisht' is an old Devon word for eerie or uncanny; Wistman's Wood on Dartmoor was said to be where the ghostly Wisht Hounds were kept.

dex.text: A dwarf oak bent double by the wind, furred with moss and hung with lichen, its roots wrapped round a granite boulder. It has stood still for four hundred years and will thank you not to rush it.
dex.fact: Wistman's Wood is one of the highest oakwoods in Britain: its pedunculate oaks grow stunted and twisted among granite boulders, thickly coated in mosses and lichens.
